rootCause: The live video generator preview is a DOM/CSS renderer.
The downloaded video was produced by a separate canvas renderer with independent layout, text placement, active-word styling, and recorder settings.
The canvas export omitted the preview-style rounded active word container and did not draw word separators between centered word parts.
The export path relied on default MediaRecorder bitrate behavior and did not wait for the site fonts before recording.

previewPreservation.details: The visible preview component markup and classes were not redesigned. The preview word-window sizing logic was moved to a shared helper with the same constants and behavior so export can use the same frame model.

details: Canvas export now builds a frame plan from the same canonical active-frame state used by the preview.
Export text rows use the shared preview word-window sizing.
Active Morse/plain text words draw with rounded highlight containers and consistent text colors.
Centered word rendering now draws the slash/space separators that appear in preview text.
Lightbulb export placement was moved into the same centered composition plan and active bulb frames draw simple sparkle marks.

resolutionQualityOptions.details: The selected export quality is visible in the tool and controls the canvas backing dimensions used by captureStream.

details: Canvas backing size is set to the selected native pixel dimensions.
MediaRecorder is configured with resolution-aware video bitrates: 5 Mbps for 720p and 9 Mbps for 1080p.
The export path waits for Space Mono and Space Grotesk before recording frames.
Canvas image smoothing is disabled for the generated vector/text frame source.

bookPreviewRegressionRisk.details: Book preview appearance is not changed. The shared preview component only imports the extracted word-window helper that preserves the previous constants. Book preview validation remains part of final branch validation.

recommendedNextStep: Review exported 720p and 1080p videos manually against the live preview, then merge to main if acceptable.
